_help: Her body. Ports on the ESP32: M1-M3 = DC motors, S1-S4 = servos, D1 = on/off switch (LED, buzzer, relay). Set installed:true when the part is physically plugged in. You can also just tell her and she edits this herself.
bodyDescription: A small tank under a foot tall. Rubber tracks, a phone for a head, two tiny arms that can lift a few ounces at most. Cannot reach tables, doorknobs, or anything useful.
